profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: I'm a New York City based engineer specializing in front-end web technologies. At Google I'm focused on making Firebase the best platform for agentic app development. I’m passionate about building teams that thrive, working closely with design partners, and making beautiful things with code ✨

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Launched Firebase Release Monitoring, a new offering for mobile application releases powered by Firebase Crashlytics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In my first year, I worked as an Engineering Resident: a one-year rotational program. My first rotation was with Google Daydream building Augmented Reality experiences. My second rotation was with the Firebase team, where I converted to a permanent role in early 2019.

On Firebase, I've worked on things like: bringing Firebase to web developers, creating common components for our design system, and the full UI redesign of Firebase Performance Monitoring.

positions.title: Tutor and Grader
positions.description:
Fall 2015, Spring 2016: Intro to Computer Programming Tutor (Python)
Fall 2017: Applied Internet Technology Grader (Node.js, Express, Handlebars)
Spring 2018: Intro to Computer Programming Grader (Python)

company.name: NYU Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences

positions.title: Teaching Assistant | Summer Immersion Program
positions.description:
Taught on a team of 6 teachers/TAs to equip 40 high school girls with fundamental CS skills (Scratch, Python, Robotics in Arduino C, algorithms, and web development). Fostered a tight-knit sisterhood around the values of bravery and resilience.

See some of the girls' final projects here: https://hq.girlswhocode.com/project-gallery?programTypes=SIP&years=2017

company.name: NYU College of Arts and Science

positions.title: College Captain
positions.description:
Served as the student liaison on administrative leadership team overseeing the College of Arts & Science College Cohort Program. As College Captain, I represented 44 upperclassman College Leaders, who in turn support the 1500 first-year students in the college.

I collaborated with administrators and university partners to revamp a year's worth of curriculum for first-year students, and implemented new design guidelines to modernize our presentations. Additionally, I fostered community between the 44 College Leaders through team building, programming, and 1:1 support.

positions.title: College Leader
positions.description:
Led and mentored a group of 34 first-year College of Arts & Science students by fostering a community between them and serving as their go-to resource for their first year at NYU.

Co-facilitated bi-weekly cohort meetings with an Academic Advisor, with curriculum based on topics such as academic challenges, campus resources, and cross-cultural communication. Promoted university initiatives around diversity and inclusion, health and wellness, academic inquiry, service, and college life

positions.title: Admissions Ambassador
positions.description: Educated university guests with detailed information about NYU's campus, academic offerings, resources, and admissions process, both in-person and over the phone. Conducted self-personalized, hour-long campus tours for groups of ~30 guests Participated in university-wide admissions events, including speaking on student panels for audiences of 400+ prospective students and their families

honors.title: 2016 NYU President's Service Award
honors.description: The President's Service Award is used to recognize students and student organizations for their civic engagement and leadership within the NYU community. I received an individual award for my commitment to mentorship for students during various phases of their academic careers, from prospective and admitted college students, to NYU upperclassmen.
honors.issuer: Issued by New York University · Apr 2016

honors.title: Dean's Scholar
honors.description: Along with my admission to NYU, I was named a Dean's Scholar and offered a 4-year, full-tuition scholarship. Additionally, this granted me a place in the College of Arts and Science Presidential Honors Scholars Program, a co-curricular program in which scholars meet in seminars and participate in study away programs.
honors.issuer: Issued by New York University · Mar 2014

volunteerExperiences.role: Training & Orientation Coordinator, Messenger Service Volunteer
volunteerExperiences.description: Oversaw admissions to the high school volunteer sector, organized and facilitated training and orientation sessions on a bi-weekly basis for all areas of the 1000-volunteer organization, collaborated with fellow Standards Committee leaders to enforce hospital policies, supervised Messenger Service volunteer shifts.
